name: App Icon Generator
description: Turn one image or SVG into complete icon sets for the web, iOS, Android, macOS and Windows
help: Choose a square image of at least 1024 × 1024 pixels, or an SVG (rendered sharply at every size). Other shapes are centred.
Padding adds space around the artwork; corner radius rounds the web, Android and Windows icons. Turn on a background to fill transparent areas.

iOS icons and the Apple touch icon cannot be transparent, so they get a background (white if none is set) and square corners; the system rounds them. Android round icons are cut to a circle, and macOS icons follow Apple's template with a rounded tile and margin.

The files go into a new folder next to the image (or the folder you choose): web favicons with site.webmanifest and an HTML snippet, an Xcode AppIcon.appiconset, Android mipmap folders, AppIcon.icns, and a multi-size app.ico.
